propositions: The inbound absence-probe port (SupportsAbsenceProbe, probe_remote implementations, inbound_probe.py, and related classifiers) has zero production callers after bug 3b5f removed all consumers (producer, dispatch arm, and router).
The port must not be used to restore same-pass issue re-creation per an earlier operator ruling, eliminating its original purpose.
Deleting the port is safe and behavior-neutral because deletion detection lives exclusively in the outbound probe chain (outbound_differ._safe_get_issue and binding_walk), which remains untouched.
The deletion leaves orphaned the config keys jira.resolved_statuses and reconciler.resolved_statuses, which is deferred to a follow-up ticket as a user-visible surface change.
A string grep across the repository and semantic symbol search both confirm no live callers of the port exist outside the port surface itself and its own tests.
